dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward the visible posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Margins appear continuous and smooth without localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-level blueish-grey tonal shifts across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A thin, vertical linear contrast disruption is visible on the right dorsal flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a singular, faint longitudinal scar or rake mark on the right side of the dorsal ridge.
